# Tocomo

Tocomo is an iOS app that plans a baby's weekly meals (ages 6 to 24 months)
with age safe cutting guides and allergen alerts, then orders every
ingredient in one tap through Instacart. Made in the US for US parents,
available in English and Spanish.

One liner: Plan the week. Skip the store.

Key facts:
- 48+ age safe recipes with cutting guides per food and age
- Weekly meal planner that becomes an Instacart cart in one tap
- Allergen tracking and food log
- Free tier: 7 recipes. Premium: $6.99/month or $39.99/year with 7 day trial
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tocomo/id6758968527
- Operated by CreaActiva LLC (Texas, US)
- Contact: hello@tocomo.co

Pages:
- https://tocomo.co (home)
- https://tocomo.co/guia-blw.html (first foods guide, Spanish)
- https://tocomo.co/privacy (privacy policy, EN/ES)
- https://tocomo.co/terms (terms of service, EN/ES)

Tocomo is educational and never a substitute for pediatric advice.
